## [1.4.1](https://github.com/Globberry/morphe-patches/compare/v1.4.0...v1.4.1) (2026-11-11)

### 🐛 Bug Fixes

* [Export] suite - remove the crashy LP4eSlPPu patch, make every patch ([9178d3b](https://github.com/Globberry/morphe-patches/commit/9178d3b611fd13fda2e38ecef8f48f598c971973))

patches.name: Keyflow Export Pro Gate Bypass
patches.description: Allows exporting projects that use Pro features by bypassing the Pro gate in the export pipeline.

patches.name: Keyflow Trusted Signer Bypass
patches.description: Always report the app signature as trusted so Pro is not reset when opening a project or exporting.

patches.name: Keyflow byYKY0yXO Signer Bypass
patches.description: Return a dummy signer identity string during export so the export path does not fail on re-signed APKs.

patches.name: Keyflow f6olX Goto Fix
patches.description: Replaces failure goto sites in f6olX with nop so all code paths reach Premium (Keyflow 1.5.10 export).

patches.name: PairIP License Check
patches.description: Neuters PairIP license verification so the app runs without a valid license.

patches.name: Pro Unlock
patches.description: Forces all Pro features enabled and replaces the Google Play confirmation with a fake success, so ad surfaces never appear.

patches.name: Signer Identity
patches.description: Forces the app's signer identity to match the original publisher certificate.

patches.name: [ALL] PairIP License Check
patches.description: Neuters PairIP license verification using fingerprint matching (version-robust).

patches.name: [ALL] Pro Unlock
patches.description: Forces all Pro features enabled using fingerprint matching (version-robust for method name changes).

patches.name: [ALL] Signer Identity
patches.description: Forces the app's signer identity to match the original publisher certificate (fingerprint-based, version-robust).

patches.name: [Export] 1 kts6dAU4 Gate
patches.description: Always allow Pro features in the export Pro gate (Lkts6dAU4.NMGZ06).

patches.name: [Export] 2 kts6dAU4 Throw
patches.description: Do not throw the Pro-required exception (LwNKvkk7) during export.

patches.name: [Export] 3 y88yfJ73C Allow
patches.description: Always let the export pass the LCtCUGg.y88yfJ73C abort check.

patches.name: [Export] 4 ZFJe6vx50 Skip
patches.description: Never take the export-abort branch in LZFJe6vx50.invoke.

patches.name: [Export] 5 kCg72Z4t State
patches.description: Publish PLAYING instead of PRO_REQUIRED/ERROR as export state.

patches.name: [Export] 6 LCWcMAXf Error
patches.description: Replace the pre-export error message with an empty string.

patches.name: [Export] 7 LsvcJNUbK3 Allow
patches.description: Always allow the LsvcJNUbK3 sub-check of the export Pro gate.

patches.name: [Export] 8 Diagnostics
patches.description: Log the whole export flow to logcat (tag KFPro). Read with: adb logcat -s KFPro

patches.name: [Export] 9 Toast
patches.description: Show a toast naming the reason the export was cancelled.
